full_zh: 背景：我自己建的每日健康检查 every settled transaction has its Braintree fee 报警，page 了 on-call。我不是 assignee，但把 page 转给了自己，负责根因、postmortem 和加固。
问题：先切片，缺失的费用 100% 是新 standard-ACH 路径上的银行账户交易，约 200 个商户、每天约 1000 万美元。追到单笔交易，payment_instrument_sub_kind 是 NULL，而费用品类是 BT_ 拼上 sub-kind，SQL 里拼 NULL 还是 NULL，所以没有品类可匹配，费用静默没生成，也没有任何报错。

我做了什么：往回读 promote 流程，发现一个函数有两个重载，最后的 MERGE 调的是没有银行账户分支的那个，把正确值覆盖成了 NULL。有人提议把 ACH 加进检查的排除名单，我写下数字，说明检查是对的、费用是真的丢了，所以不加。队友先落了止血，我写 postmortem（含 e2e 为什么没抓到的四个原因），并做结构修复：合并成带默认参数的单一函数，用 versioned migration 删掉旧签名，加了从 promotion 到费用生成的 e2e 测试。
结果：根因在线程里几分钟内给出，双重载的设计被整个移除，新的 e2e 覆盖了这条链路。我说明确：止血 PR 是队友的，我负责根因和加固。
为什么这样做 / 学到：无法映射的 instrument 必须 fail loudly，不能什么都不产出；NULL 传播是 SQL 的属性，所以规则要放在接缝上，而不是某个调用点。
full_en: A daily health check I'd built, 'every settled transaction has its Braintree fee', paged the on-call. I forwarded the page to myself and had the root cause in the thread within a few minutes. Scoping showed that a hundred percent of the missing fees were bank-account transactions on the new standard-ACH path: about two hundred merchants, roughly ten million dollars a day. The fee calculation builds the pricing category as 'BT_' concatenated with the payment-instrument sub-kind. For these transactions the sub-kind was NULL, and in SQL concatenating NULL gives NULL, so no category matched and no fee was written, silently, no exception. The reason: one function had two overloads, and the shared final MERGE called the one-argument version, which had no bank-account branch, and overwrote the correct value. There was pressure to add ACH to the check's exclusion list. I put the numbers in writing: the check was right and the fees were really missing. A teammate landed the stopgap first. I owned the root cause, the postmortem, and the hardening: one function with a defaulted parameter, a versioned migration that drops the old signature, and an end-to-end test spanning promotion through fee generation. The rule I pushed: an unmappable instrument must fail loudly, not emit nothing.

full.zh: 出错时大声失败（不要静默）
full.example: An unmappable payment instrument should fail loudly instead of silently producing no fee.
The worst part was the silent failure: NULL propagated and no error was ever raised.
I had the root cause in the thread within a few minutes.

hook.en: on the order of ten million dollars a day
hook.zh: 每天约一千万美元的量级
hook.example: About two hundred merchants, on the order of ten million dollars a day, were affected.
A hundred percent of the missing fees were standard-ACH bank-account transactions.
I ruled out timing lag because every age bucket had zero percent coverage.

starl.example: I scoped the problem by slicing the missing fees by payment type and source.
I walked it back through the promote procedure until I found the overwriting MERGE.
After the stopgap I made a structural fix: one function, and the old signature dropped.

followups.example: A teammate landed the stopgap first, and I owned the root cause and the hardening.
In billing I would fix forward, and issue a correcting entry if the wrong state was consumed.
The postmortem listed four test gaps that explained why the end-to-end suite missed it.

relp.example: I pushed back with data when someone proposed excluding ACH from the check.
I wasn't the assignee, but I took ownership of the postmortem and the hardening.
I closed the loop by writing down why our tests could not see the bug.

senior.q: How would you decide whether to backfill the missing fees, and who needs to be involved?
senior.why: 面试官在探：你在账务场景下如何处理已经产生的错误状态，而不是只修代码。
framework: 先量化：缺失的笔数和金额，以及是否已经被下游消费
再判断：灰度阶段影响小，可能不需要，但这个判断要有数据和负责人确认
再说方法：fix forward，必要时 backfill，已被消费的状态用更正分录而不是回滚
最后说协作：财务和出款方要知情，并确认补录口径
senior.best_practice: 账务里的错误状态一旦被下游消费就不能当没发生，所以用更正分录补上才有可追溯的历史。是否 backfill 取决于量级和已有影响，需要数据支撑并让相关方确认，而不是工程师单方面决定。这里我没有声称自己做了 backfill，说的是方法。

terms.example: If the wrong state was already consumed downstream, I would post a correcting entry, not roll back.
Before any backfill I would loop in finance to agree on the amounts.

senior.q: How do you make sure a silent-NULL class of bug is caught earlier next time, beyond this one fix?
senior.why: 面试官在探：你是在修一个 bug，还是在消灭一类 bug。
framework: 先说接缝：在边界处对不可映射的值显式报错，不让 NULL 往下传
再说设计：单一函数加默认参数，新分支选不到不完整的实现
再说测试：用真实形态的 fixture 跑完整链路，断言费用而不只是路由
最后说监控：保留这个每日健康检查，它正是发现问题的那道网
senior.best_practice: NULL 拼接静默得到 NULL 是 SQL 的属性，指望每个调用点都记得检查是不现实的，所以规则放在接缝上。让错误无法被选到，比提醒大家小心可靠得多。测试要用会触发该路径的数据，否则测试通过也说明不了什么。

terms.zh: 让非法状态无法被表达出来
terms.example: One function with a default parameter makes the incomplete implementation impossible to pick.
I put the rule at the seam, not at each call site.

senior.q: How would you tell the difference between a health check that is wrong and one that is right but inconvenient?
senior.why: 面试官在探：你面对压力要求关掉告警时，如何用证据判断。
framework: 先拿样本：随机取一笔被告警标出的交易，手工追到底，看费用是否真的缺失
再看切片：缺失是否集中在一个新路径，对照组是否正常
再排除其他解释：时序滞后、数据绕过等
最后写下数字再决定，不靠嗓门大小
senior.best_practice: 告警被怀疑时，最有力的反驳是一笔追到底的真实例子加一组切片数据。对照组正常、时序和绕过都被排除后，结论就很难被质疑。把数字写下来，让分歧从意见变成事实，也让别人能复核。

terms.example: Fast ACH was the control group: its sub-kind was populated and its fees were fine.
I kept the discussion evidence-based by writing the numbers into the thread.

senior.q: What would you change in the team process so that incidents like this are caught before they reach production?
senior.why: 面试官在探：你能否从一次事故上升到流程和组织层面的改进。
framework: 先说灰度：新路径放量前，要有该路径的完整端到端检查
再说评审：新增分支时检查所有共享函数是否都覆盖了它
再说测试策略：fixture 覆盖每种 payment type，跨 promotion 到费用生成
最后说传播：把 postmortem 的测试盲区变成团队的测试清单
senior.best_practice: 一个事故反映的往往是流程缺口：新路径上线时没有覆盖它的端到端检查。把盲区写成清单，下次新增路径就有现成的核对项。流程改进要小而具体，才会真的被执行。

terms.example: I would add a pre-launch checklist item: every shared function covers the new payment type.
The postmortem pushed a systemic fix rather than blaming one person.
